raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Changes

Follow-up to #43812 and #43736. Together they admit decoder SWA bounded replay with DP attention under the breakable prefill CUDA graph, but the DP-geometry swap from #43812 skipped itself while the stream was capturing and graph replays never re-run the late-layer loop, so inside the graph the late-layer MoE gather kept the full-shape counts while the hidden states were the tail block (only consistent when the shape fits within `max_running_requests x 128`).

- `late_layer_dp_counts` takes `in_graph`: prefill graphs pad every DP rank to one shape, so the tail block is rank-uniform and the counts come from the captured shape with no collective. The capture bakes the geometry in; replays inherit it.
- `enter_late_layer_dp` uses device ops only (`full_like` for the count tensor, `clamp` on the runner's static non-padded scalar) so it is capture-safe and rebounds per replay.
- The model loop decides `tail_in_graph` before computing the counts.

## Accuracy

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on 2xGB300, TP2/DP2/EP2, MegaMoE, DSpark, breakable prefill graph, bounded replay on, evaluated with the GB300 CI test's evaluators (`max_running_requests` 32 per rank, so the in-graph tail block of 4096 rows is smaller than the captured 4096-8192 shapes).

| Eval | Score | CI threshold |
|---|---:|---:|
| GSM8K (zero-shot chat, 200) | 0.980 | 0.95 |
| MMLU (500) | 0.926 | 0.90 |

DSpark accept length 3.4-4.3. A 10-shot completion GSM8K smoke check on the same box gave 0.925 with the graph vs 0.910 eager, both with replay and DP2.

nodes.body:
Validation, done on 2xGB300 (`khoa-pham-gb300-2gpu`) by running the GB300 CI test's mixin locally at TP2/DP2/EP2 with MegaMoE, DSpark, `--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable`, `--enable-decoder-swa-bounded-replay`.

- Prefill graph captured shapes up to 8192 under a shared MAX_LEN bucket; with 32 running requests per rank the in-graph tail block is 4096 rows, so the 4096-8192 shapes ran the late layers on a block smaller than the shape, which is the regime this PR fixes.
- GSM8K (zero-shot chat, 200): 0.98 (threshold 0.95). MMLU (500): 0.926 (threshold 0.90). DSpark accept length 3.4-4.3.
- A 10-shot completion GSM8K smoke check on the same box: 0.925 with the graph vs 0.910 eager, both with replay and DP2.

At TP2 the model needs the Engram host table and `--mem-fraction-static 0.86`.

@@ -13,20 +13,22 @@
 
 
 def late_layer_dp_counts(
-    forward_batch: ForwardBatch, local_late_rows: int
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch, local_late_rows: int, *, in_graph: bool
 ) -> Optional[List[int]]:
-    # Bounded replay shrinks an extending rank's late layers to its tail, but the
-    # TP-MoE gather / combine there spans every DP rank, so each rank needs all
-    # ranks' late-layer row counts. Eager forwards only: every rank takes this
-    # branch together, and graph replays never reach the late-layer switch.
+    # The TP-MoE gather / combine in the late layers spans every DP rank, so each
+    # rank needs all ranks' tail row counts.
     early = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu
     if early is None:
         early = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu
-    if early is None or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+    if early is None:
         return None
     if len(early) == 1:
         # Local-only counts (MegaMoE with a DP LM head): no peer geometry to share.
         counts = [local_late_rows]
+    elif in_graph:
+        # Prefill graphs pad every DP rank to one shape, so the tail block is
+        # rank-uniform and the capture bakes it in; replays never run this code.
+        counts = [local_late_rows] * len(early)
     else:
         # Tail row counts are host-known; the CPU group avoids a device sync.
         counts = torch.empty(len(early), dtype=torch.int64)
@@ -56,8 +58,13 @@ def enter_late_layer_dp(forward_batch: ForwardBatch, counts: List[int]) -> tuple
         fb.num_token_non_padded,
     )
     fb.global_num_tokens_cpu = counts
-    fb.global_num_tokens_gpu = torch.tensor(
-        counts, dtype=torch.int64, device=fb.global_num_tokens_gpu.device
+    # Device ops only: this runs inside prefill graph capture, where a host copy
+    # would be recorded against pageable memory.
+    gpu = fb.global_num_tokens_gpu
+    fb.global_num_tokens_gpu = (
+        torch.full_like(gpu, counts[0])
+        if len(set(counts)) == 1
+        else gpu.new_tensor(counts)
     )
     fb.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu = counts
     # The MoE gatherv reads its sizes from the logprob counts when present.
@@ -70,11 +77,13 @@ def enter_late_layer_dp(forward_batch: ForwardBatch, counts: List[int]) -> tuple
     # With attention TP=1 the invariant scalar also describes local MoE rows.
     # Preserve an idle peer's zero bound even when it carries fabricated rows.
     local_rows = counts[get_parallel().attn_dp_rank if len(counts) > 1 else 0]
-    real_rows = min(local_rows, fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu)
-    fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu = real_rows
+    fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu = min(
+        local_rows, fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu
+    )
     if fb.global_num_token_non_padded is not None:
-        fb.global_num_token_non_padded = fb.global_num_token_non_padded.new_tensor(
-            real_rows
+        # Clamp the runner's static scalar so a graph replay rebounds it per batch.
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded = torch.clamp(
+            fb.global_num_token_non_padded, max=local_rows
         )
         fb.num_token_non_padded = fb.global_num_token_non_padded
     set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch(fb)

@@ -4153,6 +4153,11 @@ def _forward_layers_hc_pre_from_prev(
             self._check_late_layer_tail_readers(forward_batch)
             attn_backend = get_attn_backend()

+        tail_in_graph = (

+            and tail.scatter_indices is not None
+            and is_in_breakable_cuda_graph()
+        )

@@ -4167,12 +4172,8 @@ def _forward_layers_hc_pre_from_prev(
